items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Herb Ellis was in the rhythm section, me and Herb, and Buddy Collette happened to be on that same show.

ctx.x: But for a while there, most of the major television shows employed a goodly number of major name Jazz musicians.

Well, for instance, all of the shows... I did Danny Kaye's show, and that had... Herb Ellis was in the rhythm section, me and Herb, and Buddy Collette happened to be on that same show. And the Jonathan Winters Show, we did that same one, and they were mostly Jazz musicians, Jazz-orientated musicians. And the Carol Burnett Show, same way. I did four years with Danny Kaye, four years with Carol Burnett (and in between that I'm doing Jonathan Winters), and four years on Flip Wilson's show. So that's twelve years of…
